title: Route record
description: Point-crawl route between two locations, inside a Manager ag-foundry-import/0.2 package (Locations 1.10.0+, Manager 0.27.0+). Manager passes it to Locations after the locations. A wrong type or out-of-range number skips that route with a reason. Journeys (incl. behaviours) are play state and never in the record.

visibility.description: Recommended; players' view is set by discovery_state.

leg_km.description: Default: the world setting (GM Setup > Routes; 5 km since Locations 1.13.1, a world that saved its own value keeps it). Legs = ceil(distance / leg), at least 1.

hazard_base_percent.description: Default 5 (Locations 1.13.1+; was 10). Rounded to a whole number. After a leg with no hazard the chance doubles (max 100); after a hazard it resets. 0 = never.

terrain.description: Longer text is cut to 80 characters. Players who can see the route see it.

discovery_state.description: Default unknown (players see nothing). Used only when the route is created; re-import never changes it.

name.description: Longer text is cut to 200 characters. Players who can see the route see it: never name a hidden place.

notes.description: GM only. Longer text is cut to 5000 characters.
